violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -C-Store cabinets below beverage line have rough/worn surfaces. -C-Store cappuccino machine is held closed with tape. -Cracked plastic container used to hold single use packages.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -C-store spill below soda bib in cabinet below beverage line. -Dust/debris at white box fan and in cabinet below steam well hot hold in kitchen. -Frost build up at interior upper surface of 2 door glass coke cooler.

Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Equipment/utensil was not air-dried or allowed adequate draining after sanitizing. -Cutting board at make table was put away wet, moisture and debris at underside.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Case of individual wrapped paper towels stored on floor in dry storage area. -Bag used for wet mops stored on corner of dry storage shelf and employee bag and jacket stored on other corner of same storage shelf. *Corrected on-site, items removed from shelf.--Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -Food trays in kitchen are not stored inverted.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc. …) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Debris below shelves of walk in freezer.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Cloths left out at chlorine spray bottles used throughout day until dingy. -C-store sani spray bottles found with 200ppm+ chlorine solutions.--Sani Bucket was not made/available at kitchen prep area.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Deli Express Chuck Wagons with pull dates of 2/2.--Several Badlands sandwiches and Green Chili burritos were not date stamped.

Contaminated food disposition. — --Potentially hazardous food held for greater than four hours between 41F and 140F was not discarded when conditions require. -Breakfast item with pull time of 11am still on warmer at 1:30pm. COS-disposed of immediately.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface used with potentially hazardous food was not cleaned every four hours while in use or as frequently as required. -Tongs used at burgers stated as washed daily.--Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Some food debris on "clean" pizza oven trays.--Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Food spill/residue at interior surfaces of oven.
